g.text: Pareto frontiers for execution time and DRAM traffic

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526378

g.text: Percent change from NoPF. Lower is better on both axes. Rings identify nondominated points within each panel.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526378

g.text: Primary panels retire 200M instructions each. The EOF panel retires 450,000,001

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526378

g.text: and overlaps the primary PageRank window. Each run warms up for 50M instructions.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526378
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526378

g.text: Traffic includes demand reads, prefetch reads, and writes. Tied policies share

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526378

g.text: a marker. Connecting segments link measured frontier points.
